Name: No Need To Forget - Divorce Reconciliation
Author: glacierpinecone
Description:
[center][left][b]Preface: [u]Please scroll down for the machine-translated English version.[/u][/b] My English is not good, so the introduction was machine translated after writing the Chinese version. There may be errors, please forgive me. The dialogues and events of this Mod are all in Chinese, then machine translated into English. If you want to translate them into more authentic English or other languages, I welcome it very much.[/left]
[left][/left]
[size=5][b]简介[/b][/size]
[left][center][b][size=4]为什么爱要靠遗忘才能回来？[/size][/b][/center]
[size=3]我是一个非常喜欢破镜重圆和追妻火葬场剧情的人，但我发现在星露谷中，离婚之后就是一条死路：配偶会恨你入骨，想挽回只能去女巫小屋把TA的记忆全部清除——可是“忘掉我们之间的一切”算什么复合？我想要TA永远记得我、记得我们之间的一切，重建信任，修复感情，对彼此有更深入的了解，然后情不自禁地再次被彼此吸引——爱不就是这样吗？所以这个mod诞生了！[/size][/left]
[/center]
[size=3]已知： 旧档可用（装mod之前离的婚也可以）。不会影响第一次婚姻和普通友谊。兼容多婚mod。理论上兼容其它剧情拓展。似乎不能兼容多人游戏。[/size]
[size=3]如果你发现了Bug，请告诉我并附上SMAPI日志！我会尽量解决。[/size]
[size=3]如果你喜欢我的mod，想要支持我的工作，链接在这里：[url=https://cdn.phototourl.com/free/2026-06-06-a3013a30-d50c-44ee-abf6-37a10219186c.jpg][/url][url=https://cdn.phototourl.com/free/2026-06-06-a3013a30-d50c-44ee-abf6-37a10219186c.jpg]赞赏作者[/url][/size]
[center][size=5][b]内容说明[/b][/size][/center]
[size=4][b]1.离婚后的阶段划分 [/b][/size]
[size=3]离婚后，前任的好感度不再被锁死为0，而是分为5个阶段（下面所有的数字都是可以用模组管理器调节的）：[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Hurt（0-3心）：还在气头上，只有最爱的礼物有50%概率收下，好感涨幅是正常的20%。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Distant（3-6心）： 敌意减轻，收礼概率随好感度提高（60%→80%→100%）， 好感涨幅是正常的50%。[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Softening（6-8心）： 恢复正常收礼， 好感涨幅是正常的80%，这时候前任会开始说软话。[b]当好感满8心时，如果离婚满21天 （如有设置8心事件，则还需要看完事件）就能送出花束，重新约会，进入下一个阶段！[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Reconciliation（8-10心）： 好感正常增长。[b]好感满10心、复合满7天之后即可再次求婚！ [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Remarriag（10心之后）： 请珍惜你的第二次婚姻，婚后配偶偶尔会说一些表达珍惜和庆幸的话。[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]2.已包括的内容 [/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]12位原版可约会NPC的专属对话：星露谷中的每位原版可约会NPC都有自己的专属对话！包括5个阶段的日常对话，收下礼物/拒绝礼物的对话，接受表白/求婚的对话以及因为不同原因拒绝的对话，总共添加了768条。[i]【我尽量让TA说的话符合原版人设，自制对话的比例同样可以调节。】[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]1份通用对话：为了兼容其它mod添加了可约会NPC的情况，准备了一份通用对话。同样包括以上内容，总共添加了46条。[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]3.待添加的内容[/size][/b]
[size=3]我计划为12位可约会NPC制作专属的复合时期8心/10心事件，以及对应的邮件，以让TA的形象更加丰满。但这是一个大工程，我会在之后的更新中完成。[/size]
[b][size=4]4.前置模组[/size]
[/b]必备：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
推荐：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[size=4][b]5.其它[/b][/size]
[size=3]我个人精力有限，而且英文不是很好，所以这个mod的对话是用中文写然后机翻为英文的。如果有人能够把它翻译为更地道的英文或其它语言，我非常欢迎！（文本放置于i18n文件夹中）如果你进行了翻译，请联系我，我会在此备注以便使用！[/size]
[size=3]另外，虽然我多次测试都没有问题，但为了以防万一，还是建议在离婚前先备份存档。[/size]

[center][size=5][b]Introduction[/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][size=3]Why should love only return through forgetting?[/size][/b][/center]
[size=2]I'm a huge fan of second-chance romance — especially the kind where the one who messed up has to grovel their way back into their love's heart. But in Stardew Valley, divorce is a dead end: your ex-spouse will hate your guts forever, and the only way to win them back is erasing their memory. What kind of reconciliation is "forgetting everything we ever had"? I want them to remember me — remember everything between us — and then rebuild the trust, mend the bond, come to understand each other more deeply than before, and helplessly fall for each other all over again. Isn't that what love is? And so this mod was born!
[b]Known: Works on existing saves (divorces from before installing the mod count too). Does not affect your first marriage or ordinary friendships. Compatible with Polyamory Sweet. Compatible with other story expansions in theory. Multiplayer does not seem to be supported.[/b]
If you find a bug, please tell me and attach your SMAPI log! I'll do my best to fix it. If you like my mod and want to support my work, you can use this [url=https://cdn.phototourl.com/free/2026-06-06-a3013a30-d50c-44ee-abf6-37a10219186c.jpg]Encourage the author[/url] or donation button.[/size]
[center][b][size=5]Details[/size][/b]
[left][b][b][size=4]1. The stages after divorce[/size][/b][/b][/left]
[/center]
[size=2]After a divorce, your ex's friendship is no longer locked at zero. Instead, it moves through five stages (every number below can be adjusted in the mod config menu):[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Hurt (0–3 hearts): Still angry. Only their loved gifts have a 50% chance of being accepted, and friendship grows at 20% of normal speed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Distant (3–6 hearts): The hostility eases. Gift acceptance rises with friendship (60% → 80% → 100%), and friendship grows at 50% of normal speed.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Softening (6–8 hearts): They accept gifts normally again, friendship grows at 80% of normal speed — and their words begin to soften. [b]At 8 hearts, once the divorce is at least 21 days past (and, if an 8-heart event has been set up, after you've watched it), you can offer a Bouquet, start dating again, and move on to the next stage![/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Reconciliation (8–10 hearts): Friendship grows at full speed. [b]At 10 hearts, after 7+ days back together, you can propose again![/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Remarriage (after 10 hearts): Please treasure your second marriage. Your spouse will occasionally say lines about how much they cherish it, and how glad they are to have you back.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]2. What's included[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Unique dialogue for all 12 vanilla romanceable NPCs: every romanceable NPC in Stardew Valley has their own custom lines! This covers daily dialogue for all five stages, lines for accepting or refusing gifts, lines for accepting your bouquet or proposal, and lines for turning you down for various different reasons. A total of 768 dialogues have been added. (I did my best to keep everyone true to their vanilla personalities. The ratio of custom dialogue is adjustable as well.)[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]One generic dialogue set: for compatibility with mods that add romanceable NPCs, a generic set covering everything above is also included. A total of 46 dialogues have been added.[/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]3. Coming later[/size][/b]
[size=2]I plan to create unique 8-heart / 10-heart reconciliation-era events for all 12 romanceable NPCs, along with matching letters, to flesh each of them out even further. It's a big project — I'll complete it in future updates.[/size]
[size=4][b]4.[/b][/size] [size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=2]Required: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url] Recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/size]
[size=4][b]5. Else[/b][/size]
[size=2]My personal energy is limited, and my English is not very good, so the dialogue for this mod is written in Chinese and then machine-translated into English. If anyone can translate it into more idiomatic English or other languages, I would greatly appreciate it! (The text is placed in the i18n folder.) If you have translated it, please contact me, and I will make a note here for future use![/size]
[size=2]In addition, although I have tested it multiple times without any issues, it is still recommended to back up and archive before getting a divorce, just in case.[/size]
